name: Narodno sabranie (National Assembly)
notes: 52nd National Assembly (opened 2026-04-30). Seats by parliamentary group, from the Assembly open-data endpoints https://www.parliament.bg/api/v1/coll-list/bg/2 (group sizes) and https://www.parliament.bg/api/v1/coll-list-ns/bg (240 members). Groups, not parties: DB and PP formed separate groups after the election.
